_entries.content:
The issue requires that columns added to a `Table` instance should default to the `Table.highlight` setting. I have modified `rich/table.py` to achieve this by changing the default value of the `highlight` parameter in `Table.add_column` to use `self.highlight`.

First, I updated the `Column` dataclass to allow `highlight` to be `None`, as it will now be dynamically set by the `Table` instance.
Second, I updated `Table.add_column` to default the `highlight` argument to `self.highlight`.

I will now submit the patch.

```python
# Changes made:
# 1. In rich/table.py, Column.highlight default changed from False to None.
# 2. In rich/table.py, Table.add_column highlight default changed from None to self.highlight.
```

I will use `submit_patch` to finalize the changes.

The repository issue has been fixed by ensuring that when a column is added to a `Table`, its `highlight` property defaults to the `Table`'s own `highlight` setting.

Specifically, I made the following changes in `rich/table.py`:
1.  Updated `Column.highlight` default value from `False` to `None` to allow dynamic setting.
2.  Updated `Table.add_column` signature to default the `highlight` parameter to `self.highlight`.

The patch has been submitted.
